plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/staging/room-33/plate-01/candidate-lifted-1920x864.png, room-33 attempt 2, the standard 20:9 crop -- frame.json); the broken wall (attempt 3) shares the frame, and the void is where it broke.
walkableNote: The chamber's floor, in front of the walls.

scaling.note: ROOM 33'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad stood with his feet at y 793 and was drawn 366 tall; along 0.26 a row, 342 at the band's far edge and 383 at its near.

entrances.note: In through the gap, at left.

hotspotsNote: EVERY ROCK SURFACE is the whole chamber above the floor: doc 05's 'every rock surface', and doc 54's THE WALLS is the same rock. A LISTEN on it is a tap, placed where the click lands. THE VOID is never a hotspot (doc 54: 'No line here says where the void is').

THE GAP.note: Back through the gap to Room 34's tunnel. Doc 57 writes THE GAP from Room 34's side only, so from here it is a stub (errata 72 F).

obstacles.note: Thad's lamp, set down on the floor: he walks round it, never over it.

lamps.note: Thad's lamp on the floor. It slows to stillness across the score's ninety seconds (invariant 8); otherwise it is only a flame (invariant 9).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. A bare click on the rock is LOOK, and LOOK is the joke that empties out (errata 70 F).

void.note: Where room-33 operation 3 broke the wall (art/staging/room-33/plate-after): tuning, judged by Tyler's ear (doc 57 F2).

tune.cuesNote: Doc 07 #11 R_TRUTH: 'In F2, twenty seconds into the tuning arc, he stops mid-phrase, tunes his A, and continues. He is the only character in Consolation who notices anything, and it is never remarked upon.' Doc 06: 'The fiddler in the Nugget corrects first, about twenty seconds in.' Heard far off, under the score, and never remarked upon (errata 116).

listening.note: Doc 28 Part Five and doc 45; errata 70 C-F and 71 E (errata 99 H).

figureLight.note: Errata 109, from the pre-playthrough art audit: Thad is drawn in even light so he can go in every room, and here, where the room around him averages 12.8 (of 255) against his 57, he read as pasted on. Graded to about 38, the room's surround plus 25 -- the margin the lit rooms keep -- under a warm lamp multiply gentle enough to keep his coat blue, as the Nugget's (variant B, Tyler, 2026-11-01). A measurement, not a verdict: Tyler's playthrough decides.
